question: What was the yearly trend of import unit value (EUR per kg) for the main fuel product chapter with the largest increase in import value between 2021 and 2022, specifically Petroleum oils (HS4 2710), from 2018 to 2025?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs4 IN ('2710')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: +13.7 % (2018–2025)
insight: The yearly trend of import unit value for Petroleum oils (HS4 2710) from 2018 to 2025 shows an overall increase.
The import unit value rose from 0.54 €/kg in 2018 to 0.62 €/kg in 2025, a change of +13.7%.
The highest import unit value was recorded in 2022, reaching 0.87 €/kg.
This peak in 2022 stands out compared to other years in the period.
However, the data only includes trade rows with known quantities, so some volumes and unit values may be missing.
